title: Technical English — Course 3, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 8

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the label session take place?
tasks.audioText: The electrical workshop will hold a short session on technical labels next Tuesday at two. Students will review common warning symbols, unit abbreviations and equipment identification plates. The instructor will provide a reference sheet at the start. Students should not remove labels from any training equipment during the exercise.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. What will the instructor provide?
tasks.audioText: The electrical workshop will hold a short session on technical labels next Tuesday at two. Students will review common warning symbols, unit abbreviations and equipment identification plates. The instructor will provide a reference sheet at the start. Students should not remove labels from any training equipment during the exercise.

tasks.prompt: An equipment identification plate usually contains information such as the model, serial number and rated values. A technician copied the details into an inspection record and checked the units carefully. The technician also noted a warning symbol near the connector. If a label is damaged or unreadable, the information should be confirmed through the approved documentation rather than guessed. Reading 1. Which details may appear on an identification plate?
options: The model, serial number and rated values

tasks.prompt: What should happen if a label is unreadable?
options: The information should be confirmed using approved documentation

tasks.prompt: The serial number ___ in the inspection record.
Choose TWO details commonly found on an equipment identification plate.
A symbol or text that indicates a possible danger is a ___.
A warning symbol is unclear. What should you do?
options: Guess what it means and continue.
Check the approved reference sheet or ask the instructor to confirm it.
Ignore the symbol because it is small.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of technical labels and symbols in a logical order.
options: Read the model and serial details
correctOrder: Read the model and serial details

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words describing how technical labels and symbols help people identify equipment and understand important information.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: the response explains how labels/symbols help identify equipment and communicate important information (0–2); it refers to checking the relevant legend/key or approved information rather than guessing an unfamiliar symbol (0–2); ideas are clearly connected with understandable grammar (0–2); label/symbol/equipment vocabulary, spelling and punctuation are accurate (0–2).
